reviews.name: Aditi M.
reviews.text: I've genuinely never felt underwear this comfortable. The CloudSilk bralette is the first wireless bra that actually gives me support AND feels like wearing nothing at the same time. I threw away all my old bras. Not exaggerating.

reviews.name: Kavya R.
reviews.text: As a plus-size woman, finding intimates that actually fit well has been a lifelong struggle. VelvetSkin's 2X fits my body perfectly — no rolling, no digging, no adjusting. And the size range goes up to 4X. Finally a brand that includes us.

reviews.name: Nisha P.
reviews.text: The bodysuit under a blazer is chef's kiss. Completely invisible, no lines, no bunching. I wore it through a 12-hour workday and forgot I had it on. The modal fabric breathes beautifully even in Chennai humidity.

items.question: What size should I order?
items.answer: We offer XXS to 4X. Use our Fit Quiz for a personalized recommendation based on your measurements, body shape, and comfort preferences. If you're between sizes, our CloudSilk fabric stretches to accommodate — size down for more compression, size up for a relaxed feel.

items.question: What is the 100-Day Comfort Guarantee?
items.answer: Wear your VelvetSkin pieces for up to 100 days. If you're not 100% in love with the comfort, we'll give you a full refund — even if they've been worn and washed. We're that confident.

items.question: How do I wash CloudSilk?
items.answer: Machine wash cold in a delicates bag, lay flat to dry. The fabric is engineered to maintain its softness, shape, and elasticity for 200+ washes. We recommend avoiding fabric softener — the modal fibers are naturally soft and don't need it.

items.question: Is the packaging discreet?
items.answer: Yes. All orders ship in unmarked matte packaging with no product descriptions visible. We respect your privacy completely.
